reviews.title: Nice little PSU!  No need for 1k watt!
reviews.comment: Works perfectly!  However the cables are grossly long for a SFF build.  I will have to figure out how to snip and re-pin to fit cables inside case.  Not an issue.  I knew this day would come!

reviews.comment: I have 2 of these in different computers, they have been working great. Cables are good quality

reviews.title: Do not buy the 750W
reviews.comment: Bought the 750W because it was drastically cheaper. Like multiple others on here, I was sent a unit that did not function. Will not be buying another ASUS PSU if the quality control is this bad. Hooking this unit up to my motherboard fried the RGB lights in my fans and two of my SSDs.
reviews.author: Coral Serrano

reviews.title: Best PSU ever
reviews.comment: I have a ITX build with Four ROG components, Loki PSU, ROG RYUO 240, B-550 i Gaming Strix, ROG Strix Rx 6700 xt GPU, and it looks great wnen the rgb is synced together with Aura Sync.
